title: Balanced Subsets
statement: The task is to count, modulo 998244353, non-empty subsets of n distinct integers (n up to 2·10^5, values ≤ 3n) with at most two unstable elements, x being stable when exactly two of x+1, x+2, x+3 are present. The two largest elements are always unstable, so all others must be stable: consecutive gaps are 1 or 2 with no '2,2' or '1,1,1', counted by a DP over values.
